title: Launch activation briefing: staffing, channels, and release-timeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidated activation plan that sequences blog, email, social, webinar, and release-note publication. Includes staffing windows, primary/backup content owners, timezone-aware timing, fallback messaging templates, and a fast roll-back play. Objective: a single live doc for comms and ops during the two-week launch window to minimize confusion and reduce mean time to mitigation.

decisions: Single source of truth: release notes will live in Drive link above and be frozen 48 hours before launch unless critical fixes appear.
Two-step publish: blog + email go live at T0, social amplification staggered T0+2h and T0+24h to capture global windows.
Webinar will be an educational deep-dive, not a product teaser. Recording posted to docs after initial playback moderation.
Fallback routing: when latency SLO breached, route traffic to rdx-4x-small with a 5% traffic canary then escalate if metrics persist.
Paid budget capped to $3,000 for this activation cycle and owned by Growth marketing.
